name: destructo-play
note: A person's first level through the controls, on romdev, GL and WebGPU: the same bits on both; the control never fires (tests/destructo-play.mjs). romdev only: no native game runs.

name: destructo-controls
note: Shoulders and triggers do nothing (and the old build, run with --control and DESTRUCTO_CART_DIR, reacts to them); the d-pad, North and South do act, at a fixed power.

name: destructo-newcomer
note: The human-like newcomer clears level 1 (a real landmark) with all eight seeds within par plus 4, and a player with eight times the aim error does not (the full sweep is tests/destructo-human.mjs).

name: destructo-loading
note: A level nothing was built for (dm restart with ASYNC_RESTART) shows the loading screen on every frame: the spinner moves, the text is there, the progress only goes up, no frame over 100 ms; the control (OLD_WAIT, the main thread waiting for the build) fails. romdev only.
